verdict.rationale: E2B's core purpose is running AI-generated code in secure, isolated cloud sandboxes (Firecracker microVMs) rather than on your own server. The docs cover code execution via runCode and commands.run, kill/timeout controls, and outbound network restrictions through allow/deny lists. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the isolation/security guarantees (all evidence is first-party claims).
